basic_details.job_title: District Collectorate Madurai Support Person Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: District Collectorate Madurai, through the District Child Protection Unit Madurai, is recruiting candidates for the Support Person post on a contract basis. Eligible applicants must obtain the application form from the Madurai District Collectorate website, fill it completely with required certificates, and submit it in person or by registered post or speed post to the District Child Protection Unit, District Collectorate Campus, 3rd Floor. age_limit.details: Minimum age requirement: 25 years of age.

Alternatively, a degree in the field of child development with at least three years of working experience in the relevant field. | Minimum age requirement: 25 years of age.

content_sections.heading: District Collectorate Madurai Support Person at a Glance

rows.details: District Collectorate Madurai / District Child Protection Unit Madurai
G.O. (Ms) No. 23, Dated 12.08.2026 (Under Section 39 of The Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012)
Post Graduate in Social Work, Sociology, Law, Psychology, Child Development, Child Welfare, Health or related fields
Offline (In person or by registered/speed post)

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Completed applications must be sent to the following postal address: Department of Child Welfare and Special Services, District Child Protection Officer, District Child Protection Unit, District Collectorate, Master Plan Complex, 3rd Floor, Madurai - 625 020 Applicants must submit the application in an envelope superscribed with "Application for Empanelment as Support Person - Madurai District". Submissions can be made in person or through registered post or speed post.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Post Graduate degree in Social Work, Sociology, Law, Psychology, Child Development, Child Welfare, Public Health or related fields connected with child development and child welfare. Alternatively, a degree in the field of child development with at least three years of working experience in the relevant field. Minimum age requirement: 25 years of age.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Application form with bio-data and a recent photograph Age proof certificate Residential address proof certificate Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets Work experience certificates Identity proof copy Copies of registration and recognition documents if applying on behalf of an organization

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications are scrutinized according to the rules and procedures specified in the Government Order and guidelines. Eligible applicants are shortlisted, and necessary verification including police background checks is conducted.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications must reach the designated office on or before 30 October 2026 by 5:00 PM. Late submissions, incomplete applications, and applications lacking required documents will be summarily rejected. Background checks and police verification will be conducted for candidates as per departmental procedures.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to submit the application for District Collectorate Madurai Support Person Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application is 30 October 2026 up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q2. Where should I send the completed application form?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted in person, by registered post, or by speed post to the District Child Protection Officer, District Child Protection Unit, District Collectorate Campus, 3rd Floor, Madurai - 625 020.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum age requirement for the Support Person post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a minimum of 25 years of age.

faq.question: Q4. What educational qualification is required to apply?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Post Graduate degree in Social Work, Sociology, Law, Psychology, Child Development, Child Welfare, Health or related fields, or a degree in child development with at least three years of experience.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: The total number of vacancies is not stated in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. What documents need to be attached with the application form?
faq.answer: Applicants must attach their bio-data with a recent photo, age proof, residential address proof, educational qualification certificates, work experience certificates, identity proof, and organizational registration documents if applicable.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves scrutinizing applications as per guidelines, shortlisting candidates, and conducting police background verification.
